walkthroughs.body_html: Graphite pencils run from hard H grades to soft B grades. They erase well and suit precise work. Build tone with hatching, smudging or cross-hatching.
Charcoal gives the darkest blacks and big expressive marks. Use a putty rubber to lift highlights. Spray fixative when finished or it will smear.
Fineliners give clean, equal lines for illustration. A biro is brilliant for layered crosshatching, like Old Master drawings. Ink cannot be erased — commit boldly.
